purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt/billing software. It creates periodic billing (teiki seikyuu) collection data, processing patient hospitalization records and periodic billing management information to produce output files for regular insurance claim submissions.

verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but the Japanese comments are actually EUC-JP encoded, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical billing system used in Japanese clinics. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~75KB; the full procedure division is not shown but the structure is unambiguous. No COMP-3 usage despite being a financial/billing program, which is somewhat unusual but consistent with GnuCOBOL usage patterns in this project.
